planets.name: HD 118203 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Liesma with a 6.13-day year, found in 2005.

text.card: HD 118203 b was found in 2005 by Haute-Provence Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Liesma. Its orbit and size follow Zhang et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ZHANG_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2005, disc_facility Haute-Provence Observatory, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 6.1349847, pl_radj 1.14, pl_bmassj 2.14

quotes.title: HD 118203 b
quotes.card: HD 118203 b, formally named Staburags, is a jovian planet that takes only 6.13 days or 147 hours to orbit the parent star HD 118203 at a distance of 0.07 astronomical units.
quotes.introduction: The exact mass was not known since inclination was not known until TESS detected the planet.
